podcast.body: This song was originally intended for New Riders of the Purple Sage after the band asked Robert Hunter to be their bassist. The original lineup for NRPS included members of The Grateful Dead, such as Jerry Garcia, positioning them as an offshoot of The Grateful Dead. "The song was originally supposed to be for new writers of the purple sage after that band asked Hunter to be their bassist."
